svg.title: The boundaries of a relate process and their defaults
svg.desc: A relate process has five boundaries. Statements reach the store and can be limited with read-only and safe mode; network clients reach it only on loopback with a generated credential; local files reach LOAD CSV only from a named directory. Releases and extensions come in only after a signature or a pinned checksum is checked, and documentation comes in as reference text, never as instructions.
